metadata.title: ZeroTrustAssessment
metadata.description: Perform a Zero Trust Assessment of your Microsoft 365 environment.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00206.ps1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$passwordType' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.

warnings: A package file exceeds the 35 MiB per-file analysis limit.
